items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: The first band they had, uh, consisted of this Burt Sigerson... Don Ellis, who was an extremely good saxophonist... and the leader was a man named Bob Canfield

ctx.x: So many musicians down there, but the impression of the trombone is especially interesting to me. I think of somebody like, I wonder what happened to Ellis Stratkos during that period. Where was he?
